title: Local colour. Work in all you know. Make them accomplices.
html_source:
Stephen got his info on Hamlet from a book by Brandes, a chapter of which was titled ‘local colour’.

http://www.columbia.edu/~fms5/ulw09.htm

make them accomplices refers to the Socratic Method in argument of getting the adversary to agree with statements which you later demonstrate disproves the adversary’s argument.
